source.title: Appointment of New Senior Delegates (October 2018)
source.content:
As a result of our recent application period, two new Senior Delegates have been appointed. For the Asia Japan region, the Board received the application of Yohei Suzuki and he has been re-appointed for the position. For the Europe West region, the Board received the applications of Laura Ohrndorf and Lorenzo Vigani Poli. After deliberation, they decided to appoint Laura Ohrndorf for the position.

No applications were received for the regions of South America & Middle America and Africa, so the WCA Board will assume these roles until suitable replacements are found.

In North America, a new system is being implemented to enhance the senior delegate role for the region. The documentation and explanation of this system is [here](https://docs.google.com/document/d/1JXAD3HbqfBudN4lf2ilc08jTpjdhJQb5xneMzzXU-VQ/edit?usp=sharing).
<!-- break -->
The appointments will be effective on October 1, 2018. You may find all the applications [here](https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/11N6skCjAfWbPNnktHAmZ40dV4B0b6MHx).

We would like to thank Daniel Sheppard, Donovan Hale, Tim Reynolds, and Rafael Werneck de Andrade Cinoto for the hard work and dedication that they gave in the Senior Delegate positions previously. Additionally, we want to thank all the applicants for their willingness to help the WCA and the Speedcubing community even more than they currently do now. Good luck to the new Senior Delegates in their roles!

translation.title: 新任高级代表任命公告（2018 年 10 月）
translation.content:
近期申请结束后，两位高级代表的人选已确定。亚洲日本地区方面，董事会收到了 Yohei Suzuki 的申请，并决定续任。西欧地区方面，董事会收到了 Laura Ohrndorf 和 Lorenzo Vigani Poli 的申请，经讨论后决定任命 Laura Ohrndorf。

南美洲与中美洲地区、非洲地区均未收到申请，因此在找到合适接任者之前，由 WCA 董事会代行这些职责。

北美洲地区正在实施新制度，以加强该地区高级代表的工作。制度文件及说明见[此处](https://docs.google.com/document/d/1JXAD3HbqfBudN4lf2ilc08jTpjdhJQb5xneMzzXU-VQ/edit?usp=sharing)。

这些任命将于 2018 年 10 月 1 日生效。所有申请材料可在[此处](https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/11N6skCjAfWbPNnktHAmZ40dV4B0b6MHx)查看。

感谢 Daniel Sheppard、Donovan Hale、Tim Reynolds 和 Rafael Werneck de Andrade Cinoto 此前担任高级代表期间的辛勤工作与付出。同时，感谢所有申请者愿意在现有工作之外，进一步帮助 WCA 和速拧社区。祝新任高级代表工作顺利！
